introduction.system_description:
This is My Table-Top RPG called Reclaim the Realm (RtR) it is a d20 ruleset that focues primarily on Combat and Exploration. It is set in a Fantasy world that has a technological and culural development that can be compared to the renaissance era.
In this system each player controls a character that can perform various abilities depending on the chosen class and selected abilities. This character gets stronger as they adventure at which point they unlock more abilities, improve existing ones and get more powerful in general. The system's rules are mainly designed to support combat and exploration.
introduction.keywords_description: During this document you will find Keywords which are bold and underlined, example: [D20 TEST]. These Keywords are here to clearly indicate that the text is refering to a game machenic or how precisly it can interact with other mechanics.
introduction.d20_test_description: The core mechanic for which uncertanties are resolved is the [D20 TEST]. A [D20 TEST] requires the acting individual (usually the player) to roll a d20 and add a bonus to the result which is stated by the relveant ability. This result is then compared to a Difficulty Threshold ([DT]). If the result meets or exceeds the [DT] the result is a success. Additionally if the d20 die rolled is a 20 the result is a critical success, if the die shows a 1, it is a critical failure. What impact these reults have is stated in the relevant ability/mechanic.
introduction.d20_test_specializations_description: There are various specific [D20 TEST] that have their own keywords to simplify the text. Some examples include [MARTIAL TEST], [SPELL TEST], [STABILITY TEST], [DODGE TEST], [TOUGHNESS TEST], [WILLPOWER TEST]. The specefic of which will be explained later on.
introduction.difficulty_threshold_description: The difficulty of any [D20 TEST] is measured by the Difficulty Threshld ([DT]). The [DT] should be exlusivly based upon the difficulty of the action the actor attempts. Below are examples on what the [DT] number translates to in difficulty. It should be kept in mind that different forms of a [D20 TEST] can achieve significantly higher bonuses.
introduction.difficulty_threshold_5: Trivial task for an avarage person
introduction.difficulty_threshold_10: Challenging task for an avarage person
introduction.difficulty_threshold_15: Difficult task for an avarage person
introduction.difficulty_threshold_20: Difficult task for a trained person in that task
introduction.difficulty_threshold_25: Difficult task for an expert in that task
introduction.difficulty_threshold_30: Difficult task for a genius in that task
introduction.difficulty_threshold_35: Impossible task for almost all mortal person
introduction.advantage_disadvantage:
There are 2 common ways to modify a [D20 TEST], the first one is to just add or subtract a flat number to the test or set the [DT] higher or lower. The second one is to grant advantage/disadvantage.
[ADVANTAGE]: You roll the d20 twice and take the better result.
[DISADVANTAGE]: You roll the d20 twice and take the worse result.
You can only benefit from one instance of [ADVANTAGE] or [DISADVANTAGE] at a time and if a [D20 TEST] has both, they cancel each other out.
introduction.abilitiies_description:
Every mechanical action performed by a charceter or npc is an ability. Each Ability specificies relevant characteristics such as range, target(s), and usage cost. Additionally it describes how the ability works and what it does.
The Ability also contains Tags which are indicators and later used to indicate what abilities can interact with other abilities.

character_creation.creation_description: The Collapse of the Ancient World has left civilizations ravaged and isolated and the wilderness more dangerous than ever. Your Character will have to be strong, fast or cunning to survive out there and explore the remains. Use the following procedure to create your character:
character_creation.creation_step_assign_attributes_skills: Assign your starting Attributes and Skills
character_creation.creation_step_set_character_values: Set the Statistics and Values of your Character
character_creation.creation_step_choose_perks_abilities: Pick your starting Perks and Abilities

species.species_description: Your species represents your biological make and your ancestry. Species also have certain traits that make them unique to others.
species.species_human_decription: Humans are the unique since they only started to emerge during the unification of the Elemental planes in the Prime Elemental and did not form during or before the elemental turmoil. They are a very communal species and require social interaction in their lives. They are the most versatile of all people and also have a strong drive to make a name for themselves and achieve something in their lives.
species.species_dwarf_description: Dwarves originally formed in the Elemental Plane of Earth as an evolution of advanced earth elementals. A sizeable amount of dwarves still remain there, however most of them migrated to the Prime Elemental eventually. Their connections still remain strong and they mostly reside in mountanous regions where the connection the their native plane is the strongest. They have a very strict society and strongly adhere to the codes of their clan or society. Thus they are very suspecious of people outside their communities, however once you earn they trust they will welcome you as their own.
species.species_elf_description: Elves originate form the Elemental Plane of Air after evolving from the advanced AIr Elementals. Their ability to live there was limited since they are not able to fly innatly and thus most of them migrated towards the Prime Elemental when it formed. They are remarkable for their slender and tall physique and are the first people to master the ethereal plane and have built a strong connection. Which has evolved them to the point everytime a new elf is born instead of creating a new soul, a soul of a previous dead elf inhabits them and merges with their.

origin.origin_description: Your origin defines the place you grew up and your early childhood, while this also slightly impacts your character’s abilities and skills, most importantly, it adds a lot of flavour and depth to your character. In the following steps you are presented with tables which you can roll, this however is optional. It merely represents the likelihood of where people are usually born, and can of course also be chosen freely.
origin.birthplace_description: This table represents the location of your birth and where you spent most of your childhood. Depending on what you select, this affects your choices later on, so be aware that certain options might not be available to you later on. When you have chosen your Location, you can roll on the Family Table according to your Location.
origin.early_training_description:
This represents what training or tutelage you recieved during adolescence which is usually heavily influenced by your parents. You gain [ADVANTAGE] on any [CHA] [D20 TEST] when interacting with persons of the same profession or background. This step also grants you extra an extra class skills, extra starting coins, and other bonuses.
If this skill is also a class skill for your chosen class you can instead choose a different one.
origin.life_events_description: You can choose up to 3 Life Events that happened to your character. There are multiple Tables to choose from and you can choose multiple memories from the same table but you can’t choose the same life event multiple times.
origin.adventuring_goal:
When creating your character you should pick one Adventuring Goal which should be the defining personal Goal and adventuring Motivation that you are persuing on the side. When creating your goal work with the GM to ensure you are both on the same page.
However keep in mind that you are usually working in an adventuring group so you will have to be aligned with the rest of the party for persuing your goal. Below you find some example Goals that you can use and adapt:
origin.achieving_adventuring_goal: Upon Completion of your Adventuring Goal. You increase your maximum Fate Points by 3. TODO add link to Fate

classes.class_description:
Each player character must choose from one of the following classes below. The Class determines the core set of abilities your character is able to use out- but especially in-combat. When your character reaches a higher [LEVEL], their abilities become stronger and they will gain newer ones. Your class will later also allow you to specialize in different ways. After having chosen your class, you have to make choices for skills and certain abilities your class possesses, such as spells.
Below are summaries for each Class which show you the key characteristics of each class which are explained below:
classes.class_hp_per_level: Represents your Class Bonus for determining your [HP] increase each [LEVEL].
classes.class_martial_level_progression: Determines the factor with which your [MARTIAL LEVEL] increases with your [LEVEL]. The higher the value the better your character is at fighting using their martial prowess, superior tactics, or charismatic leadership.
classes.class_spell_level_progression: Determines the factor with which your [SPELL LEVEL] increases with your [LEVEL]. The higher the value, the better your character is at casting spells. A value of 0 indicates no spellcasting ability.
classes.class_defenses: The Factor with which your Defense Values increase with each [LEVEL]. These are relevant when attempting to resist or evade incoming dangers
classes.class_class_attributes: Each class has 3 Class Attributes, which are relevant for the classes most important abilities. Additionally these abilities have a higher attribute limit and are each increased by 2 when selecting the class.
classes.class_skills: Your class skills, these skills have their rank and rank limit increased by 2.
classes.class_perks_description: Each Class also has a specific set of Perks which are imporvements towards your character that you can pick and choose to best fit your Chracter. Which will be explained in more detail.TODO add link to Perks

attributes.attributes_description: Each Attribute represents one Aspect of your Character and is denoted by a number, an average person is expected to have an Attribute of 0. A higher Attribute grants you a higher bonus for Tests made with that attribute, or might increase different bonuses or other values. Attributes also will interact with most of your Abilities and a higher Attribute generally allows you to use certain Abilities more effectivly.
attributes.assigning_attributes:
All your Characters Attributes start at -2 and at first [LEVEL] you have 22 Attribute Points availible. You can spend one at Attribute Point to improve an Attribute by 1, however you can't improve an Attribute beyond your Attribute Limit, which is 3. Class Attributes are however an exception to this as they are start at 0 and their Limit is also increased by 2.
As your [LEVEL] increases and the game progresses you will gain more Attribute Points
attributes.str_description: [STR] represents your physical Strength. In game, it additionally reflects your ability to wield melee weapons and damage with bows and thrown weapons, as well as your carrying capacity and jumping distance.
attributes.agi_description: [AGI] represents additionally the Agility of a character as well as their reflexes as well as their finesse. It specifically reflects your accuracy with a melee Attacks, your movement and as your ability to dodge attacks and other threats.
attributes.con_description: [CON] represents your bodily health as well as your endurance and the ability to resist poisons or other harmful effects targeting your body. Additionally every second point in [CON] increases your [HP] for each [LEVEL] you have, furthermore each second point increases your natural lifespan by 10 years. Conversely, if your [CON] value is negative, every second negative point decreases your [HP] and lifespan.
attributes.int_description: The [INT] Attribute represents your Intelligence and ability to reason about problems, recall information, prediction, and imagination of 3D environments, for example it represents how many techniques you can know at the same time and how many skill points you have.
attributes.spi_description: The [SPI] Attribute represents how strong your connection to the elemental planes and the Aether is as well your mental fortitude and spiritual health, it most importantly affects your ability to use spells and other supernatural techniques.
attributes.per_description: The [PER] Attribute represents your physical senses and the ability to perceive details and weak spots or even unnatural senses and your accuracy of ranged attacks.
attributes.cha_description: The [CHA] Attribute represents how likeable you are and your ability to sway others for your cause, it additionally improves certain abilities.
attributes.attribute_tests: During the game, you will often be asked to make a [D20 TEST] where you have to add one of your Attributes as a bonus to the roll. For example the GM or an Ability might call for a [STR] [D20 TEST]. Upon which you will roll a d20 and add your [STR] to the Result. Most commonly you will also add another Value in addition to an Attribute to the Result, such as a Skill Rank which will be explained below:

skills.skills_description:
While an Attribute represent the Natural Ability to perform a task within the field of Attribute. Skills represent training in a specific task or field of tasks. Skills are represented by Ranks which are denoted by a number, the higher your Skill Rank is the better your Training in the Skill and the more likely your Character will be able to successfully complete Tasks related to the Skill.
Skill are intedeed as the main mechanic to resolve Situations outside combat.
skills.assigning_skills:
At the start Every Skill starts at Rank 0. You can increase the Rank of your Skills by spending Skill points of which you have 5 + [INT]/2 (rounded down) for every [LEVEL] your character has. If you spend one Skill Point you can improve the Rank of the Skill by 1.
Unless stated otherwise the maximum Rank of your Skills is equal to your [LEVEL]. Each Class also gives you access to Class Skills for each of which the current Rank and Rank Maximum are increased by 2.
skills.stacking_class_skills: If you get the same Skill as a Class Skill from 2 different Sources you can instead pick a different Skill you don't have as a Class Skill already.
skills.skill_tests: During the game you will be required to make [D20 TEST] where you can add your Skill Rank as well as an Attribute as a bonus to the roll. For example the GM or an Ability might call for a [STR] Athletics [D20 TEST]. Upon which you will roll a d20 and add your [STR] and your Ranks in Athletics to the Result.
skills.helping_others: If another Person is making a [D20 TEST] you can aid them if they are willing and you are not otherwise Distracted. When doing so the Person you are helping makes their [D20 TEST] as normal and you repeat the same [D20 TEST] they are making. You divide your result by 10 (rounded down) and the Person you are aiding can add it to their Result. It is possible for multiple Persons to aid someone.
skills.athletics_full_description: Represents your ability to climb, swim, jump and other forms of physical movement and balance.
skills.awareness_full_description: Represents your ability to notice threats, spot objects far away and making out details in a distance, Awareness is assumed to take no more than a few seconds.
skills.awareness_short_description: Represents your ability to notice threats, spot objects far away and making out details in a distance.
skills.culture_full_description: Knowledge about Civilizations, History, Important Figures and Traditions.
skills.deception_full_description: Represents your ability to deceive, twist the truth, act as someone else and confuse others with your words and actions.
skills.investigation_short_description: The ability to discern details, find hidden meanings, search for secret entrances/treasure, reach conclusions, figure out illusions.
skills.investigation_full_description: Investigation is used to discern details, find hidden meanings, search for hidden treasure or secret rooms, reach conclusions based on clues or figure out illusions.
skills.intimidation_full_description: Your ability to frighten others and make them act on your will.
skills.medicine_full_description: Understanding of Medicine, the Anatomy of most living beings and knowledge of herbs, minerals and other substances with healing properties.
skills.nature_full_description: Knowledge about Beasts, Monsters, Plants and certain exotic creatures and the ability to interact with them.
skills.persuasion_full_description: Your ability to sway others for your cause or convince them to aid you in your endeavours or barter with them.
skills.stealth_full_description: Your ability to effectively hide or move silently as well to conceal objects.
skills.supernatural_full_description: Knowledge about creatures, secrets sects, cults and other groups related to the cosmic and elemental planes.
skills.survival_full_description: Your ability to navigate the Wilderness, scavenge for food as well as your general sense of direction.
skills.thievery_full_description: Thievery is used where fast and precise motions are required. It also allows you to lock pick locks and disarm traps with Thieves Tools.
skills.crafting_smithing_full_description: The ability for forging or shaping metal objects and Equipment. Can be used for crafting most weapons or Armour.
skills.crafting_alchemy_full_description: Knowledge about alchemy and chemestry that can be used to brew potions or create acids or poisons.
skills.crafting_jewewlry_making_full_descriptio: Expertise in creating rings, necklaces and other forms of Jewewlry as well as manipulating and analysing gems and crystals.
skills.crafting_tailoring_full_description: Sowing cloth as well as work with leather to create various equipment of clothing including boots, cloak, hats and others.
skills.crafting_woodworking_full_description: Proficiency with tools to create objects mostly made out of wood like furniture, shields or certain weapons like spears, bows, crossbows, or arrows/bolts.
skills.passive_skills: Certain skills might also be used by the GM in a passive way. Instead of calling for a relevant [D20 TEST] with the Skill the GM might just ask if a player has a sufficiently high enough Skill rank in the relevant Skill or the highest out of all the players. Awarness and Investigation are particularly useful for this.

character_values.level_description: Your characters current [LEVEL], it increases as your character spends time adventuring and earns [XP] as described in Level Progression. As your [LEVEL] increases it additionally improves several other values such as [HP], [STAMINA] and your Martial/Spell [LEVEL].
character_values.martial_level_description: Your Characters [MARTIAL LEVEL] is calculated by multiplying the Martial Level Progression of your Class with your [LEVEL] and rounding down.
character_values.spell_level_description: Your Characters [SPELL LEVEL] is calculated by multiplying the Spell Level Progression of your Class with your [LEVEL] and rounding down.
character_values.xp_description: Experience Points. Experience is accumulated during play by adventuring, defeating Monsters, solving Quests, good role-play and other achievements the Game Master deems worthwile. A certain [XP] Total is required to get to a higher [LEVEL] , when getting to a higher level the current [XP] is not reset, instead you keep your total and have to achieve
character_values.ap_description: Action Points. Most Abilities requrire Action Points to be spent which is a measure to how of their time the Ability consumes during their [ROUND]. The more [AP] a character has available, the more they can do during their turn. A Character starts with 3 [AP] and gains more as they [LEVEL] up.
character_values.mp_description: Movement points. It is a measurement to determine how much someone can move during Combat, one Movement Point is equal to 1.5m (1 Square). The [MP] of a Character are equal to 6 + [AGI]/3 (rounded down).
character_values.martial_damage_description: When attacking with weapons the damage you inflict on them depends on your [STR]. There are 3 types of damages and the one you have to use depends on the weapon used.
character_values.light_damage_description: This damage is used when using an unarmored attack or any Weapon Attack with weapons that have the light property.
character_values.medium_damage_description: This damage is used when making a Weapon Attack with a melee weapon equipped in one hand or when using ranged weapons that do not have fixed damage (e.g. Bows).
character_values.heavy_damage_description: This damage is used when making a Weapon Attack with a melee weapon equipped in two hands.
character_values.hp_description:
Health Points. Represents how much damage you can take before going unconscious. [HP] is calculated using the following Formula:
Species [HP] Bonus + (Class [HP] + [CON]/2) * [LEVEL].
character_values.dropping_to_0_hp_description: When your Character drops to 0 [HP] they receive the [UNCONCIOUS] status effect. If the character is currently in combat, they also have the option to drop to Death's Door before going unconscious.
character_values.temp_hp_description: Temporary health points. Some spells and special abilities confer [THP] to a creature. [THP] aren't actual [HP]. they are a buffer against damage, a pool of hit points that protect you from injury. When you have [THP] and take damage, the [THP] are lost first, and any leftover damage carries over to your normal hit points.
character_values.temp_hp_additional_info: It is important to note that [THP] does not benefit from any [DR] and they can't be restored, however if you receive [THP] again you can choose to either gain the new ones or keep the [THP] you have. Additionally, if you are at 0 [HP], receiving [THP] doesn't return you to consciousness or remove Death's Door. Unless a feature that grants you [THP] has a duration, they last until they're depleted, or you finish a long rest.
character_values.stamina_description:
[STAMINA] is your energy reserve with which you can replenish your Resources like [HP] and [MANA] and is used up when performing physically demanding tasks. Your maximum stamina is calculated with the following Formula:
[CON] + [LEVEL] + [MARTIAL LEVEL].
It can be expended during a short rest and are regained after a long rest.
character_values.mana_description:
Your [MANA] represents an energy reserve you expend when drawing power from the elemental planes and the aether to cast spells. Your maximum [MANA] calculated the following way:
3 ∗ [SPELL LEVEL].
It can be replenished by using stamina during a short rest and are also regained after a long rest.
character_values.defenses_description: This section explores your characters defenses against all sorts of harm that the character will likely face during their adventures.
character_values.save_bonus_description: The Bonus is used when the defender themselves has to make a defensive test called a [SAVE] for their defensive characteristic. Such a [SAVE] is a [D20 TEST] using the Bonus of the defensive value.
character_values.stability_description:
A representation of the character's resistance agaisnt being forcefully moved or crushed against their will.
Stability Bonus: [STR] + [LEVEL] ∗ Stability Proficiency (rounded down).
character_values.dodge_description:
A representation of how good the character is at evading danger.
Dodge Bonus: [AGI] + [LEVEL] ∗ Dodge Proficiency (rounded down).
character_values.toughness_description:
A representation of the character's bodily health and ability to resist internal injuries, poisons and concussions.
Toughness Bonus: [CON] + [LEVEL] ∗ Toughness Proficiency (rounded down).
character_values.willpower_description:
A representation of how well the character can resist being mind-controlled, feeling fear or resisting other mind affecting effects.
Willpower Bonus: [SPI] + [LEVEL] ∗ Willpower Proficiency (rounded down).
character_values.damage_resistance_description:
Damage Resistance ([DR]) provides flat damage reduction against incoming damage, this importantly does not reduce damage that targets your [THP]. The most common form of this is granted by armor which provides [DR] against physical damage.
[DR] is written in the following way: [DR] 5 physical
character_values.fate_description: Characters are able to twist fate in their favour in order to fulfill their destiny. Every Character has access to 3 Fate Points which is their maximum unless stated otherwise. Characters regain all their Fate Points after taking an extended Long Rest. Fate Points can be spent in the following ways:
character_values.fate_usage_reroll: You can re-roll any dice you rolled. If your rolled multiple dice at once (example Spell Cast Test or Damage Roll) you have to re-roll all of them.
character_values.fate_usage_extra_ap: You gain 2 extra AP for the current Round. Can only be used once per Round.
character_values.fate_usage_reduce_damage: When you recieve damage you can reduce it by 10 + 2*[LEVEL].
character_values.fate_usage_nat_20: Your next [D20 TEST] will have a die result of 20.
character_values.alignment_description: A characters alignment roughly describes their moral and idiological outlook. Every character and most NPC's have one. It is important to realize that these are not hard and characters can change their allignment during their lifetime. An allignement consists of one Moral and one Ideiological component.
character_values.alignment_additional_detail: For a more detailed analysis I recommend the following:
character_values.special_movement_description: There are various types of special movement that allows you to move around more efficiently in certain circumstances. Special movement is accompanied by a number of meters in parentheses (X) that designates how many meters can be moved when spending 1 [MP].
character_values.special_movement_swim: Creatures with swim speed can easily navigate bodies of Water. Creatures with swim speed reduce the difficulty of Tests to navigate Water by 10.
character_values.special_movement_climb: Creatures with climb speed can easily scale vertical surfaces. Additionally creatures with Climb speed reduce the difficulty on climb Tests by 10.
character_values.special_movement_burrow: Creatures with Burrow speed can traverse through earth, sand or similar terrain.
character_values.special_movement_fly: Creatures with Fly speed are able to soar through the air, They need to at least spend 1 [MP] each turn to move in a direction or to hover in the air to prevent falling down. If they are falling they can stop their falling by spending 4 [MP] . Additionally if a flying creature is knocked [PRONE] they immediatly drop 5 meters and only stay [PRONE] if they hit the ground.
character_values.special_movement_hover: Creatures with Hover speed can also fly through the air but are a lot more flexible and don't have to spend [MP] to stay in the air and are not affected by being knocked [PRONE].
character_values.size_description: Most humanoids are medium [SIZE] , however certain species have different ones and certain effects might change your [SIZE] . Changing your [SIZE] affects some of your physical characteristics

perks_and_abilities.perks_overview:
Perks are improvements that make your character better in various ways. Your Character starts with 3 Perk Points they can choose to spend on various Perks. Any Perk can be choosen as long as the Character meets all the requirements of the Perk and has enough Perk Points.
The availible Perks you can choose depend on your Class.
perks_and_abilities.abilities_overview:
Each time your character acts during combat they do so by using Abilities. This attempts to ensure that combat is happening in a structured manner with clear interactions. This does however not exclude Abilities from being used outside combat/unstructured play.
A Character can only use abilities that they know. All characters have a set of Standard Abilities TODO add link to Standard Abilities and can learn additional via Perks or means explained below.
perks_and_abilities.abilities_structure_explanation: All Abilities consist of the following:
perks_and_abilities.ability_name: The name of Ability, this is a unique Identification for the Relevant Ability and used when something else directly references this Ability.
perks_and_abilities.ability_tags: Each Ability has a certain set of Tags which contains meta-information and also can impact how certain abilities interact with each other. For example an Ability might give a bonus if a [TAG;Attack] Ability is used afterwards, in this case any Ability that contains the "Attack" Tag is eligable for the bonus.
perks_and_abilities.ability_cost: The Cost that has to be paid when using the Ability. Most Abilities Cost are related to time such as [AP] or [MP] but sometimes they can also cost Resources in the form of [STAMINA], [MANA] or something else entirely. If the Ability Cost can't be paid then it can not be used.
perks_and_abilities.ability_requirements: The Requirements that have to be met to be able to learn the Ability,
perks_and_abilities.ability_action: The main Part of the Ability which actually explains what it does. Abilities can consist of multiple actions
perks_and_abilities.ability_action_overview: An Ability Action itself consists of multiple parts which describe what it does and what constraints it has:
perks_and_abilities.ability_action_condition: Certain Actions have conditions that have to be met the moment they are used. In case the condition can't be met, the action immediatly resolves but no outcome goes in effect. Omitted if no Conditions are present.
perks_and_abilities.ability_action_targets: The target(s) that are affected by the outcomes of the ability. Can be individual targets, areas such as [SPHERE] or other
perks_and_abilities.ability_action_range: The Range of the Ability. Specifically the distance from you to the target Usually measured in [FIELD]. Omitted if not relevant
perks_and_abilities.ability_action_duration: Most abilities resolve immedietly however some Abilities have ongoing effects that can last for multiple [ROUNDS] or even longer, in such cases the duration is listed here.
perks_and_abilities.ability_action_action_type: Listed as just "Action" This specifies most of the time the kind of [D20 TEST] that needs to be made to determine how successful the Action is performed and additionally to what [DT] it is compared to. If Omitted the Ability will resolve and the default Outcome happens.
perks_and_abilities.ability_action_outcomes: An Ability Action can have many different outcomes, ranging from Damage, Healing, Applying Status Effects or something else completely. There also can be many different Outcomes depending on how well the Action was performed. If no outcome type is specified then that is the default Outcome that always happens any time the Action is preformed.
perks_and_abilities.ability_further_details: For more details on how Abilities interact with each other and the Syntax Works see: TODO add link to eventual Abilities Page that explains interactions in more detail
perks_and_abilities.techniques_overview: Techniques are Abilities where characters can perform extraordinary martial feats which depending on the characters power will eventually reach superhuman levels. These can be used like regular Abilities, the only difference is how they are learned and their ability to be pushed.
perks_and_abilities.technique_types_overview: There are different types of Techniques that focuses on different aspects of Martial Arts or fighting in general. In order to learn a technique you need to be able to learn techniques of it’s type. The type of the Technique can be found in it's Tags.
perks_and_abilities.technique_agile_description: Agile Techniques enable a character to show of their supernatural speed and agility. These techniques usually require a character to have a higher [AGI] Attribute.
perks_and_abilities.technique_brawl_description: Brawl Techniques enable characters to get in close combat with other people and are just relying on their body to perform techniques.
perks_and_abilities.technique_fortitude_description: Fortitude Techniques rely on the characters physical body to shrug of injuries or push themselves beyond their usual limits.
perks_and_abilities.technique_leader_description: Leader Techniques leverage the characters ability to command and empower alies or decieve enemies with their words and expressions. These Techniques techniques leverage the characters [CHA] Attribute.
perks_and_abilities.technique_tactical_description: Tactical techniques represents the characters knowledge, expierience and situational awareness of battlefield situations and how to best resolve them and gain advantages.
perks_and_abilities.learning_techniques: You can learn any technique as long as you fulfill all the requirements:
perks_and_abilities.learning_techniques_maximum: The number of techniques you know does not exceed your maximum which is 1 + [MARTIAL LEVEL] + ([INT] / 2)
perks_and_abilities.learning_techniques_type: You are able to learn technqiues of it's type. Your Class and Perks can grant you access to certain technique Types.
perks_and_abilities.learning_techniques_requirements: You meet all other requirements the Technique has listed.
perks_and_abilities.pushing_techniques: You can also push certain techniques. Pushing a Technique involves paying an additional Cost to improve the ability in some way. A push can be declared just before any of the outcomes are applied and don't have to be done when the ability is used.
perks_and_abilities.spells_overview: Spells are abilities that harness elemental or cosmic energy to manifest it or manipulate other the real world. Almost all living beings have some sort of connection to these energies but few are able to effectively harness it and even less can do so safely. Those who master spellcasting can wield tremendous power with which they can shape and destroy reality.
perks_and_abilities.spells_disciplines_overview:
Spells are categorized by disciplines that describe roughly the effect of the spell and the origin of the magical power. Characters can only learn spells of disciplines they know and certain spells can also have multiple disciplines.
Spells are split across 5 major disciplines with subdisciplines each.
perks_and_abilities.learning_spells: You can learn any spell as long as you fulfill all the requirements:
perks_and_abilities.learning_spells_maximum: The number of spells you know does not exceed your maximum which is 1 + [SPELL LEVEL] + ([INT] / 2)
perks_and_abilities.learning_spells_discipline: You are able to learn spells of it's type, if the spell has multiple types you must be able to learn all of them. Your Class and Perks can grant you access to certain technique Types.
perks_and_abilities.learning_spells_requirements: You meet all other requirements the Spell has listed.
perks_and_abilities.spells_additional_information: Since spell abilities are more complicated there is a dedicated section which explains the rules of casting spells.
perks_and_abilities.replacing_abilities: After a Long Rest you can switch out one Spell or Technique you currently know for a different one you are able to learn. After an extended Long Rest you may switch all your spells or techniques.

equipment.equipment_overview: Equipment is a general term for objects in the world, it most specifically refers to objects characters can carry, use and trade in the World of RtR.
equipment.choose_your_starting_equipment: When you are creating a character you gain 30 [GC] in addition to any other currency you recieved during your origin. You can spend this on any Equipment up to Tier 3. Any excess currency you keep to start your adventure with.
equipment.currency_description: The Currency used in the Realms are small metal coins consisting of bronze, silver, and gold. The value of a coin is also equal to the intrinsic value of the metal itself. This results in different currencies being widely accepted across civilization, although the coinage might be different. The following coins are commonly found.
equipment.coin_bronze: The lowest currency mostly made out of copper. Mostly used for buying food or basic necessities.
equipment.coin_silver: Worth 10 [BC], used for the larger purchases in daily live such as tools or trade goods.
equipment.coin_gold: Worth 100 [BC] or 10 [SC], mostly used by merchants, nobles and adventurers.
equipment.equipment_tags: Shows what type of equipment it is and contains other relevant meta information.
equipment.equipment_cost: The typical cost expected to pay for this Equipment. This can vary depending on location and circumstances.
equipment.equipment_tier: Describes how difficult it is to craft the Equipment. The higher the tier, the more difficult it is to find.
equipment.equipment_weight: How heavy the equipment is, relevant for your carrying capacity.
equipment.equipment_crafting_skills: What necesarry Skills you require for crafting this Equipment, more details in the crafting section.
equipment.equipment_description: Describes the Equipment. Also can have Gameplay effects.
equipment.equipment_granted_abilities: A set of Abilities that the Equipment grants you. Unless otherwise specified the equipment needs to be equipped in order to gain access to its abilities.
equipment.equipment_types: This is an overview of the most common Equipment Types:
equipment.equipment_type_weapon: Weapons are equipment that allow you to physically attack your foes. They come in ranged and melee variants
equipment.equipment_type_ammunition: Ammunition is required for firing most Ranged Weapons. The Ammunition will state for what Weapons it applies and the Weapon what it requires.
equipment.equipment_type_armour: Armour is protection equipment. You can only wear up to one suit of armour at the same time and while wearing it, it grants you [DR] equal to the value mentioned but it also reduces your [MP] and [DODGE] as stated in the Equipment.
equipment.equipment_type_wearable: Cloths, Boots, Gloves and other objects that you can wear on your body, specific location is mentioned in the tag, can wear multiple of the same as long as it makes sense.
equipment.equipment_type_survival: Tents, torches, ropes and other useful objects for surviving in the wilderness.
equipment.equipment_type_tool: Tools useful for crafting Equipment that can also be useful for other tasks.
equipment.equipment_type_consumable: Equipment that can only be used a limited time such as Potions.
equipment.equipment_type_commodity: Other Equipment that does not serve a specific purpose but can be used for crafting or trade.
equipment.equipment_carrying_wielding_overview: When you recieve an Equipment you can either choose to equip or carry it with you, however there are some restricitions to what and how much equipment you can carry and equip.
equipment.equipping_equipment: If an quipment is not equipped you do not get access to any bonuses or abilities unless otherwise specified. Usually equipping Items requires the use of the [ABILITY;Interction - Regular] Ability so it is wise to come prepared for combat.
equipment.equipping_hand_restriction: You can only equip one equipment in each hand, some equipments also require both hands to use certain abilities.
equipment.armour_restriction: You have to equip armour in order to gain access to it's bonuses and you can only equip one set of armour at the same time.
equipment.wearable_restriction: You can generally equip multiple wearables as long as they make sense together. Example: You can wear multiple rings or necklaces but only 1 set of boots.
equipment.consumables_restriction: You can have up to 4 Consumables Equipped simultaneously.
equipment.carrying_equipment: You can carry more with you than your equipped Equipment. It is assumed that you store that equipment in some sort of container such as a backpack or carry it otherwise with you. The only restrictions are that the size of the item is reasonable for your character to carry and that the total weight of carried and equipped items does not exceed your carrying capacity which is based on your [STR] calculated on the Table below.
equipment.exceeding_carrying_capacity: If you exceed your carrying capacity, for every additional [STR]*5 (min 1) kg you carry you suffer a cumulative penalty to the following:
equipment.lift_push_drag: Lift/Push/Drag represents how much weight you can well lift, push, drag in short bursts, useful for moving obstacles or knocking over objects with an object interaction which increases with your [STR] according to the Table below. These unlike carrying capacity are not hard values and can be modified by circumstance or a [STR] [D20 TEST] determined by the GM.
equipment.goods_and_services: Additionally here are example goods and services listed to give you an Idea of prices in RtR. Of course these can vary depending on the location or circumstances however can be a rough guideline to be used during the game.

character_progression.level_up_description: After you meet the required [XP] your [LEVEL] increases. When this happens you gain the following benefits:
character_progression.level_up_level_increase_and_dependent_va: Your [LEVEL] increases which mseans all other values dependent on your [LEVEL] increase as well.
character_progression.level_up_table: Based on the Table below your [AP] or Attribute Limit might increase as well.
character_progression.level_up_gain_2_attribute_points: You gain 2 Attribute Points you can increase your Attributes with.
character_progression.level_up_gain_2_perk_points: You gain 2 Perk Points to select new Perks.
character_progression.after_level_12: After you have reached [LEVEL] 12 for every 3000 [XP] past [LEVEL] 12, you gain an additional Attribute Point and Perk Point. However, your [LEVEL] does not increase.

exhaustion_resting.exhaustion_resting_overview: During your adventures you will accumulate damage and exhaustion. In order to recover you can rest to replenish your resources, recover from damage and remove exhaustion.
exhaustion_resting.exhaustion_overview: When characters push themselves beyond their physical Limits they suffer points of [EXHAUSTION]. For each Point of [EXHAUSTION] your character has, you gain a -1 penalty to all your [D20 TEST]
exhaustion_resting.exhaustion_limit: A character can not gain [EXHAUSTION] indefinitely, if the limits are exceeded you will suffer the penalties below as seen below:
exhaustion_resting.resting_overview: There are many different options for resting which are covered below:
exhaustion_resting.short_rest_overview: A short rest is when you quickly take your time to catch your breath. During a short rest, you can use your [STAMINA] to recover [HP], [MANA] and other class specific resources. A short rest takes 1 minute per [STAMINA] used.
exhaustion_resting.short_rest_option_1: You can spend 1 [STAMINA] and recover ([CON] / 3, (rounded up)) * d6 + [LEVEL] [HP]
exhaustion_resting.short_rest_option_2: You can spend 1 [STAMINA] and recover [MANA] equal to [SPELL LEVEL] / 3 (rounded up).
exhaustion_resting.short_rest_option_3: You can spend 2 [STAMINA] to remove one point of [EXHAUSTION]
exhaustion_resting.long_rest_overview: During a Long Rest you take time to lie down and sleep and recuperate your strength. A long rest takes an 8 hours and requires you to have consumed enough food and drank enough water for this day. A long rest can only be completed once within 24 hours. Upon completion of a Long rest, you recover the following Things:
exhaustion_resting.long_rest_benefit_1: You recover a third of your [STAMINA], [MANA] and [HP] (rounded up)
exhaustion_resting.extended_rest_overview: A extended Long Rest has to happen in a settlement in a comfortable bed with food and drink. An extended Long Rest takes at least 1 week and you gain the following benefits upon completion
exhaustion_resting.extended_long_rest_benefit_1: You recover all of your [HP], [STAMINA] and [MANA] and all your [THP] are removed.
exhaustion_resting.extended_long_rest_benefit_2: You remove all your points of [EXHAUSTION].
exhaustion_resting.extended_long_rest_benefit_3: You can recover from injuries see Injuries and Death
exhaustion_resting.extended_long_rest_activities: For each week you spend doing on an extended long rest you can spend it on an actiivity of your choice. Work with your DM when working out how the activity unfolds and where and with whom it will take place. For most activities you will be required to make a [D20 TEST] which will effect the outcome of your rest. You will have to roll on the complication table in addition to any other result of the outcome table. Below you see example activities you can perform:
exhaustion_resting.extended_long_rest_complication: When you roll a natural 1 on your [D20 TEST] you will face a complication during your Activity for this roll on the associated complication Table of the Activity.
exhaustion_resting.work_activity: Help out at a farm, tavern, smithy or else. Perform a [D20 TEST] using a relevant Skill and Attribute.

injury_death.being_reduced_to_0_hp: Being reduced to 0 [HP] does not mean your character is dead. First you have to test if you are recieving an injury (see below) and you then face a choice:
injury_death.drop_unconcious: You can choose to drop [UNCONCIOUS] and conserve your strength
injury_death.enter_deaths_door: You can try to keep on fighting and enter [DEATHS DOOR] at a risk of injuring youself and accumulating [EXHAUSTION].
injury_death.dropping_unconcious: While [UNCONCIOUS] a character can not use any abilities or act in any other way unless the GM allows it. A character can recover from being unconscious in the following ways:
injury_death.recover_unconscious_hp_restored: Any time they receive healing and some of their [HP] are restored, receiving [THP] does not restore consciousness.
injury_death.recover_unconscious_care: If someone is taking care of you (water, comfortable position) you regain 1 [HP] after 10 - [CON] (min 1) minutes.
injury_death.deaths_door: [DEATHS DOOR] is a mechanic that allows you to keep on fighting even when you are reduced to 0 [HP] however at great risks to yourself. You can only enter [DEATHS DOOR] when you are reduced to 0 [HP]. You can only end [DEATHS DOOR] voluntary at the start of a [ROUND]. While you are at [DEATHS DOOR] the following rules apply:
injury_death.deaths_door_penalty_exhaustion: At the end of a [ROUND] you gain 1 point of [EXHAUSTION]
injury_death.deaths_door_penalty_damage_first_instanc: The first time each [ROUND] you recieve damage during [DEATHS DOOR] you gain 1 point of [EXHAUSTION].
injury_death.deaths_door_penalty_damage: You also risk suffering an Injury each time you take damage (see below).
injury_death.injuries: During your adventures you can accumulate injuries which unlike regular damage are more long-term afflication and can usually only be removed via extended a long rest or powerful magic. Injuries can happen the following ways:
injury_death.injury_when_dropping_0hp: When you are reduced to 0 [HP]. Make a [TOUGHNESS] [SAVE] with a [DT] equal to 5 + excess damage your recieved beyond 0 [HP]. On a failure you recieve an Injury.
injury_death.injury_deaths_door: Each time you recieve damage while at [DEATHS DOOR] make a [TOUGHNESS] [SAVE] with a [DT] equal to 5 + damage recieved. On a failure your recieve an Injury
injury_death.other_injury_triggers: The dangers in the Wilds, certain abilities of advesaries or GM calls might cause injuries to trigger.
injury_death.reciving_injuries: When recieving an injury roll a d100 + [DT] made to resist the injury + 10 for each additional Injury you currently have. Compare the Result with a Table Entry of the corresponding Damage Type that triggered the Injury.
injury_death.injury_fire_cosmetic: You recieve a severe burn disfiguring your skin and it itches.
injury_death.injury_fire_charred_lungs: You inhaled superheated air damaging your lungs. Your maximum [STAMINA] is halved (rounded up). Recovers after 1 week of extended long rest.
injury_death.injury_fire_death: Your body is lit aflame and severe burns melt your damage your essential organs and you die leaving behind a charred corpse that is barely recognizable.
injury_death.injury_fire_extreme_death: The fire was absolute. Your body collapses into a pile of white ash and charred bone including everything you carried with you.
injury_death.death_resurrection: Death is not necesarry the end.

spell_casting_rules.spells_overview: Spells are magical phenomena that are a result of harnessing from the Cosmic and the Elemental Planes and manifesting it. Almost all living beings have a connection to the Outer Planes, but few are able to effectively and safely harness it. Those who are able to master spellcasting wield tremendous power with which they can shape and destroy reality.
spell_casting_rules.spell_disciplines_overview:
Spells are categorized by disciplines that describe roughly the effect of the spell and the origin of the magical power. Characters usually can not learn spells from all disciplines, and certain features or perks might change how you interact with spells from a certain discipline. Certain spells can also have multiple disciplines, to be able to learn this spell the character must be able to learn spells of all disciplines listed in the spell.
Spells are split into 3 major disciplines, which are again split into different subdisciplines. If you can learn spells of a major discipline, you can then also learn spells of the corresponding subdisciplines. The same goes for effects/perks that interact with major disciplines, they also affect spells of the corresponding subdisciplines.
spell_casting_rules.elemental_description: Spells from the Elemental Discipline draw their power from the Elemental Planes. They generally deal acid, fire, cold, or lightning damage or otherwise manipulate the elements
spell_casting_rules.pyromancy_description: The summoning and manipulation of fire/heat and their elementals.
spell_casting_rules.hydromancy_description: The summoning and manipulation of water/cold/acid and their elementals..
spell_casting_rules.geomancy_description: The summoning and manipulation of air/lightnning and their elementals.
spell_casting_rules.aeromancy_description: The summoning and manipulation of earth/stone/poison and their elementals.
spell_casting_rules.light_description: Spells from the Light Discipline draw their power from the Positive/Good Energy from the Cosmic Planes.
spell_casting_rules.restoration_description: Magic that revitalizes other biving beings. Able to mend wounds, empower the living and can even return people alive.
spell_casting_rules.holy_description: The purest and most virtious power, able to summon light and searing pillars of gold that burn the evil and the ability to summon angles and other good spirits.
spell_casting_rules.dark_description: Spells from the Dark Discipline draw their power from the Negative/Evil Energy from the Cosmic Planes.
spell_casting_rules.necromancy_description: The most wicked and ambitious power, able to interact with souls directly, summon the dead and bind their souls to your will.
spell_casting_rules.unholy_description: The cruelest and darkest power, able to summon impenitrable darkness and create shadowfire that hurts the living.
spell_casting_rules.psychic_description: Psychic spells are formed in the mind of the caster harnessing cosmic energy to fuel the spell.
spell_casting_rules.telekinesis_description: Channeling cosmic energy to apply physical force in the Prime Elemental.
spell_casting_rules.telepathy_description: Using your mind to directly interact with other living creatures. From harmless effects such as communicating to harmful effects like causing pain or mind-control.
spell_casting_rules.divination_description: Using your mind topPierce into the combined conciousness of all to find out what is, what has been or what could yet be.
spell_casting_rules.arcane_description: Spells that interact with raw cosmic energy to manipulate things in the Prime Elemental.
spell_casting_rules.teleportation_description: Open pathways and travel to other places in the Prime Elemental or other realities through the Cosmic Plane.
spell_casting_rules.conjuration_description: Use Energy from the Comsic Place to manifest as physical objects in the Prime Elemental temporarily or permanently.
spell_casting_rules.illusion_description: Blend the Cosmic Plane into reality to trick sentient beings into percieving something that is not there.
spell_casting_rules.casting_spells: Casting spells is the term for using Spell Abilities, which is a process of taking energy from the elemental or cosmic planes and manefesting it. However different to other abilities spells carry inherant risk, failing to properly contain and handle the energy can result in devastating consequences. Which is why magic is feared throughout the realms and spellcasters are treated with extreme caution.
spell_casting_rules.spell_cast_test: When casting a spell first a [SPELL CAST TEST] has to be made. This is done by rolling 2d6 and adding your [SPELL LEVEL] and comparing it to the spell's [SPELL DIFFICULTY] the following way:
spell_casting_rules.spell_test_cast_result_success: If the Result is equal or higher than the [SPELL DIFFICULTY] of the spell, then it is cast successfully without any adverse effects.
spell_casting_rules.spell_test_cast_result_failure: If the Result is lower than the [SPELL DIFFICULTY] of the spell or double 1s where rolled for the [SPELL CAST TEST], then it is cast successfully however before resolving the spells effects a Spell Failure occurs (see below).
spell_casting_rules.spell_test_cast_result_catastrophic_fail: If the Result is lower than the [SPELL DIFFICULTY] - 5 of the spell, then the spell is not cast at all and a Spell Failure occurs (see below)
spell_casting_rules.spell_difficulty: The [SPELL DIFFICULTY] of a spell can be found at the top right of a spell. More advanced spells or upcasting spells (see below) come with a higher difficutly and more risk when casting.
spell_casting_rules.spell_components: Spell components are additional requirements for casting the spell. It can be as simple as speaking an invocation, performing a gesture or a material component such as a specific natural environment or precious gems.
spell_casting_rules.component_verbal: Verbal components require specific words that are uttered and heard. Being deafened, unable to talk or under the effect of the Silence Spell are example which prevent you from using Verbal components. The most common Verbal components are (Invocations) which are specific words uttered in the origin language and leave no doubt that a spell is being cast. The other common verbal component are (Prayers) in which the caster beseeches the cosmos for aid.
spell_casting_rules.component_somatic: Somatic components are gestures that need to be performed to cast a spell. They require at least one free hand that is free to do gestures, but it can hold small items or weapons, but not shields. Being restrained or not having a free hand for example when climbing prevents you from performing somatic components.
spell_casting_rules.component_material: Material components are physical objects that need to be either held or somewhere present for the spell to be cast. Certain spell consume their physical components, which will be marked in brackets. Other spells require objects which have a certain value which will be stated in [GC].
spell_casting_rules.upcasting_spells: Similar to how manuevers can be pushed, Spells can be cast as more powerful versions of the normal version. When done so the spells [MANA] Cost and [SPELL DIFFICULTY] increase as described and the spell’s effect changes as stated in the spell itself. However this increase makes the spell more costly, difficult and dangerous when a magical mishap occurs.

spellFailureTable.spell_failure_description: When a Spell Failure occurs the caster is not able to tame the cosmic or elemental energies and recieves violent feedback, the strength of it depends on the failure and power of the spell. Roll a d20 and add the [MANA] Cost of the Spell. If the [MANA] cost was lowered by some other ability does not reduce the bonus here.
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_2_4: You recieve the [STUNNED III] Condition. [SAVE LOWERS] [DT] 15 [WILLPOWER] [D20 TEST].
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_5_7: You gain 1 point of [EXHAUSTION] and you lose 1 [STAMINA].
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_8_10: You recieve 4d6 damage depending on spell discipline (holy/elemental/cosmic).
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_11_13: Weak Effect depending on spell discipline.
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_17_19: You summon a [LEVEL] 3 Extraplanar Entity depending on you Spell Discipline (Elemental/Angel/Demon/Cosmic Horror). This Entity will act in it's own interrests.
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_20_22: You cast a random Spell that shares at least one Spell Discipline at the same [MANA] Cost with you being the target, or the center of the area effect.
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_23_25: Medium Effect depending on spell discipline.
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_29_31: You summon a [LEVEL] 8 Extraplanar Entity depending on you Spell Discipline (Elemental/Angel/Demon/Cosmic Horror). This Entity will act in it's own interrests.
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_32_34: Make a [DT] 25 [WILLPOWER] or [TOUGHNESS] (your choice) [D20 TEST]. On success: Receive 20d6 damage depending on your spell discipline. On Failure: you are reduced to 0 [HP].
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_35_37: Strong Effect depending on spell discipline.
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_38_40: A temporary Rift opens up right next to you in a free [FIELD] for 1d4 [ROUNDS]. It leads to another Plane depending on your Spell Discipline. Every creature or object within 2 [FIELD] of the Rift has to succeed on a [DT] 30 [STABILITY] [D20 TEST] or be sucked in. The [DT] decreases the farther you go in the following way: 3 [FIELD] ([DT] 25), 5 [FIELD] ([DT] 20), 7 [FIELD] ([DT] 15), 10 [FIELD] ([DT] 10). The Rift additionally causes harmful environmental effects while active depending on the Plane.
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_41_43: You summon a [LEVEL] 15 Entity depending on you Spell Discipline (Elemental/Angel/Demon/Cosmic Horror). This Entity will act in it's own interrests. Additionally this Entity may as it's first act summon additional reinforcements determined by the GM.
spellFailureTable.spell_failure_44+: You create a stable Rift having similar effect as the temporary Rift while it is active and in addition harmful environmental effects caused by the Rift rage rampant in the area. If the Rift is not closed within 1 hour, the area within 1d4 km will be permanently transformed by the Rift. Extraplanar Entities are also able now to freely emerge here as long as the Rift remains active.
spellFailureTable.pyromancy_weak_effect: You gain [BURNING I]. Every creature and object within 3 [FIELD] of you have to make a [DT] 15 [DODGE] [D20 TEST]. On Failure: They gain [BURNING I].
spellFailureTable.pyromancy_medium_effect: You gain [BURNING II]. Every creature and object within 5 [FIELD] of you have to make a [DT] 20 [DODGE] [D20 TEST]. On Failure: They gain [BURNING II]. On success: They gain [BURNING I]
spellFailureTable.pyromancy_strong_effect: You gain [BURNING III]. Every creature and object within 7 [FIELD] of you have to make a [DT] 25 [DODGE] [D20 TEST]. On Failure: They gain [BURNING III]. On success: They gain [BURNING II]
